scope: Complete exact-text review queue for current PRD lines and STAR results. This is a candidate clause partition, not the completed atomic acceptance denominator.
rules: Source requirements,27 complete STAR stories,7 parent gates,191 checklist contracts and every critical invariant remain authoritative.
Mechanical punctuation fragments can remain compound or overlap another requirement. They require semantic decomposition/canonical deduplication before becoming denominator units.
Candidate check links are navigation inherited from the source map; neither a Controlled/Live row nor text partition marks a fragment passing.

A canonical acceptance unit must identify actor/trigger, observable result, all required variants and proof kinds, plus current evidence for every clause. Pending or indirect proof remains unachieved.
Keep difficult variants together in all-variants acceptance groups or record independent obligations consistently before scoring. Never inflate the denominator by splitting easy outcomes.
Reference-classified prose can contain normative governance; it is not silently excluded. Deferred viewports/zoom remain deferred, with source/variants retained.
No overall percentage is available. Listener cohort denominator remains a separate50 first attempts, requiring45 unassisted successes plus critical gates; no sessions are recorded.

parentCriteria.text: 1. Connect to Jellyfin, choose accessible libraries, and restore the encrypted connection.
2. Browse, search, filter, select, and play music; manage allowed server playlists with honest permission and failure states.
3. Keep playback through navigation; restore queue, song, position, volume, shuffle, and repeat paused after relaunch.
4. Complete the [radio user stories and STAR scenarios](docs/RADIO_EXPERIENCE.md), including independent preparation/playback opt-ins, profile attribution, no-story outcomes, limits, and recovery.
5. Retain scripts, recordings, selected take, and provider-free playback across restart.

6. Check keyboard access, focus return, loading/error/empty states, and a minimum window of 1280×720 at normal zoom and ordinary larger desktop windows. After an explicit keyboard retry in All songs or Albums, return focus to recovered results, or the page heading for an empty result. Keep the retry action focused after another failure. A recovered page of results starts at its first new item and stays visible above the player. Later focus changes, navigation, dialogs and window changes take priority; background refreshes do not move focus.
7. Distinguish fixture-backed flow checks from live provider output and subjective listening quality. Do not claim user validation from an engineering review.
